description: Nepal Flooding: Road Blockages is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Planetary Response Network. We have assessed primary and secondary roads for signs of road blockages in the Rasuwa, Nuwakot and Kathmandu regions in Nepal. Coverage: Nepal. The portal files it under the publisher Planetary Response Network. Its tags are damage assessment, logistics, roads. It offers 2 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution International (CC BY). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
